title: RecoveryOps Policy Configuration
description: Configuration for the policy engine's four rule types.

retry_limit.description: Maximum number of retry attempts allowed per event.

max_attempts.description: The maximum number of execution attempts. At-limit passes; one over fails.

cooldown.description: Minimum elapsed time since the last attempt before another attempt is allowed.

min_interval_seconds.description: Seconds that must elapse after the last attempt. Just-after passes; just-before fails.

spend_cap.description: Maximum total spend (in INR) across all actions for a merchant in a calendar day.

daily_limit_inr.description: Daily spend cap in INR. Exactly-at-cap passes; one rupee over fails.

compliance_window.description: Time-of-day window during which actions may be executed (IST).
